🎨 Qwen Image 2512 + SAM3 面部修复工作流程

> 使用单一提示或批量调度，通过自动面部细节增强功能生成令人惊叹的肖像。

## ✨ 此工作流程的用途

这个 ComfyUI 工作流程结合了奎文图像 2512（一个强大的文本到图像模型）SAM3 智能油漆工至：

1. 🖼️ 根据文字提示生成高质量图像

2. 👤 使用 AI 分割自动查找并增强人脸（男人+女人）

3.🔁支持单一提示或批量提示调度创意变化

4. ⚡ 通过 CacheDiT 加速加速生成

5. 🎯 使用高级采样以获得更好的结果

非常适合：人物肖像、时尚拍摄、故事插画、面部细化和创意批量生成。

## ✨ V1.1 的新增功能

### 🔁 自动重置计数器（不再需要手动重置！）

- 替换了旧的PrimitiveInt与我的新节点自动重置整数节点

- ✅ 自动重置为0每一代之后

- ✅ 如果取消生成也会重置

- ✅ 想要运行多个批次？只需等待第一张图像完成即可 - 计数器会自行重置！

- 🎯 不再忘记重置 — 只需单击“队列”即可开始

### ⚙️ 模型格式切换

- 添加了一个简单的切换来选择模型格式：

- GGUF— 用于较低的 VRAM/量化设置

- FP8 / BF16— 在强大的 GPU 上获得完整的质量

- 🎯 选择最适合您的硬件的选项 — 无需编辑工作流程

## 📦 所需的自定义节点

将这些安装在您的ComfyUI/custom_nodes/文件夹：

|节点包 |目的|链接 |

|-----------|---------|------|

| RES4LYF|先进的采样器具有更好的质量控制 |https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF |

| SAM3_SmartInpainter|使用 SAM3 自动检测和修复脸部 |https://github.com/majidfida/SAM3_SmartInpainter |

| ComfyUI-CacheDiT|加速 Qwen 图像生成 |https://github.com/Jasonzzt/ComfyUI-CacheDiT |

| comfyui_auto_prompt_schedule|一批运行多个提示 |https://github.com/ReinerBforartists/comfyui_auto_prompt_schedule |

### 还需要：

- ComfyUI-Easy-Sam3或ComfyUI-RMBG（提供萨姆3SAM3_SmartInpainter 的 Python 包）

- Qwen 图像模型文件: qwen_image_vae.safetensors, qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors，以及您选择的检查点（例如，Qwen-Overcooked_fp8_V2.safetensors)

- SAM3型号：下载sam3.pt来自https://huggingface.co/Majidfida/Sam3/tree/main→ 放置在ComfyUI/模型/sam3/

## 🔧 如何使用

### 第 1 步：安装和设置

1. 将所有需要的节点包克隆到自定义节点/

2. 安装 Python 要求（请参阅每个存储库的 README）

3.下载模型并将其放置在正确的文件夹中

4.重启ComfyUI

### 第 2 步：加载工作流程

1. 拖动.json文件到 ComfyUI

2.等待节点加载（缺少的节点会显示红色）

### 第 3 步：选择您的模式

#### 🎯 单提示模式（默认）

- 设置切换true=单个提示 | false=批量提示 → 真实

- 编辑提示⚡单一提示⚡节点

- 点击排队提示

#### 🔄 批量提示模式

- 设置切换 →假的

- 编辑提示输入时间表提示节点（格式："0": "提示文本", "30": "下一个提示", ...)

- 设置最大帧数在PromptSchedule节点中控制生成多少个

- 点击排队提示— 它将自动浏览您的列表

### 步骤 4：脸部修复（自动）

自动工作流程：

1. 找到女人的脸 → 通过提示进行增强：“女人，精致细致的脸庞……”

2. 找到男人的脸 → 提示增强：“黑胡子的男人，精致细致的脸庞……”

3. 将两者混合回主图像中

💡 提示：修复不同的主题，链接更多SAM_SmartInpainter节点并更改提示字段（例如，“帽子”, “眼睛”, “围巾”).

### 步骤 5：调整按键设置

|参数|推荐|它有什么作用 |

|-----------|-------------|--------------|

| 最小掩模区域 | 0.001|允许检测小脸 |

| 作物填充 | 32–128|脸部周围有额外的空间，以便更好地修复|

| 修复分辨率 | 1280|更高 = 重新绘制的脸部细节更多 |

| 去噪 | 0.3–0.5|较低 = 微妙的变化，较高 = 更有创意 |

| 步骤 | 6| Qwen 图像在低步骤下运行良好 |

| cfg | 1.0|保持低调Qwen Image |

---

## 💡 专业提示

🔹 未检测到小脸或远脸？

→ 降低最小掩模区域到0.0005和文本阈值到0.25

🔹 修复看起来很模糊？

→ 举起修复分辨率到1280或1536

🔹 边缘看起来很粗糙？

→ 使用混合模式：羽毛并增加蒙版模糊

🔹 想要修复的不仅仅是脸部吗？

→ 将 SAM 提示符更改为“帽子”, “标志”, “手”— 它将找到并重新绘制该区域

🔹 批量生成太慢？

→ 启用 CacheDiT 并使用 fp8 模型以获得更快的运行速度

## ⚠️ 重要提示

🔸 此工作流程专为 Qwen Image 2512 设计— 其他型号可能需要调整参数

🔸 我不关注这个帖子— 我可能不会回复评论或问题。这是共享的，供社区使用和改进。

🔸 始终先用一张图像进行测试在运行大批量之前

---

## 🙏 积分

- 奎文图像 2512— 阿里云 / Qwen 团队

- SAM3型号— 元人工智能研究 / Majidfida (HuggingFace)

- RES4LYF— @ClownsharkBatwing

- SAM3_SmartInpainter— @majidfida

- 高速缓存DiT— @Jasonzzt

- 自动提示时间表— @ReinerBforartists

> 🎨简单的规则：从单一提示开始 → 使其完美 → 然后尝试批处理模式进行变化。

> 如果没有找到人脸 → 降低最小掩模区域。如果结果看起来疲软→提高修复分辨率.

创造快乐！ ✨👫🖼️

🎨 Qwen Image 2512 + SAM3 Face Inpainting Workflow

> Generate stunning portraits with automatic face detail enhancement — using single prompts or batch scheduling.

## ✨ What This Workflow Does

This ComfyUI workflow combinesQwen Image 2512(a powerful text-to-image model) withSAM3 Smart Inpainterto:

1. 🖼️ Generate high-quality images from text prompts

2. 👤 Automatically find and enhance faces (man + woman) using AI segmentation

3. 🔁 Supportsingle promptORbatch prompt schedulingfor creative variations

4. ⚡ Speed up generation with CacheDiT acceleration

5. 🎯 Use advanced sampling for better results

Perfect for: character portraits, fashion shoots, story illustration, face refinement, and creative batch generation.

## ✨ What's New in V1.1

### 🔁 Auto-Reset Counter (No More Manual Reset!)

- Replaced the oldPrimitiveIntnode with my newAutoResetIntnode

- ✅ Automatically resets to0after each generation

- ✅ Also resets if you cancel a generation

- ✅ Want to run multiple batches? Just wait for the first image to finish — the counter resets itself!

- 🎯 No more forgetting to reset — just click "Queue" and go

### ⚙️ Model Format Switch

- Added a simple toggle to choose your model format:

- GGUF— for lower VRAM / quantized setups

- FP8 / BF16— for full quality on powerful GPUs

- 🎯 Pick what works best for your hardware — no need to edit the workflow

## 📦 Required Custom Nodes

Install these in yourComfyUI/custom_nodes/folder:

| Node Pack | Purpose | Link |

|-----------|---------|------|

| RES4LYF| Advanced sampler with better quality control |https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF |

| SAM3_SmartInpainter| Auto-detect & inpaint faces using SAM3 |https://github.com/majidfida/SAM3_SmartInpainter |

| ComfyUI-CacheDiT| Speed up Qwen Image generation |https://github.com/Jasonzzt/ComfyUI-CacheDiT |

| comfyui_auto_prompt_schedule| Run multiple prompts in one batch |https://github.com/ReinerBforartists/comfyui_auto_prompt_schedule |

### Also Required:

- ComfyUI-Easy-Sam3orComfyUI-RMBG(provides thesam3Python package for SAM3_SmartInpainter)

- Qwen Image model files: qwen_image_vae.safetensors, qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors, and your chosen checkpoint (e.g.,Qwen-Overcooked_fp8_V2.safetensors)

- SAM3 model: Downloadsam3.ptfromhttps://huggingface.co/Majidfida/Sam3/tree/main→ place inComfyUI/models/sam3/

## 🔧 How to Use

### Step 1: Install & Setup

1. Clone all required node packs intocustom_nodes/

2. Install Python requirements (see each repo's README)

3. Download models and place them in correct folders

4. Restart ComfyUI

### Step 2: Load the Workflow

1. Drag the.jsonfile into ComfyUI

2. Wait for nodes to load (missing nodes will show red)

### Step 3: Choose Your Mode

#### 🎯 Single Prompt Mode (Default)

- Set the toggletrue=Single Prompt | false=Batch Prompts → true

- Edit the prompt in the⚡Single Prompt⚡node

- ClickQueue Prompt

#### 🔄 Batch Prompt Mode

- Set the toggle →false

- Edit prompts in theInput Prompts for Schedulenode (format:"0": "prompt text", "30": "next prompt", ...)

- Setmax_framesin PromptSchedule node to control how many to generate

- ClickQueue Prompt— it will auto-run through your list

### Step 4: Face Inpainting (Automatic)

The workflow automatically:

1. Finds the woman's face → enhances it with prompt:"woman, exquisite detailed face..."

2. Finds the man's face → enhances it with prompt:"man with dark beard, exquisite detailed face..."

3. Blends both back into the main image

💡 Tip: To inpaint different subjects, chain moreSAM_SmartInpainternodes and change thepromptfield (e.g.,"hat", "eyes", "scarf").

### Step 5: Adjust Key Settings

| Parameter | Recommended | What It Does |

|-----------|-------------|--------------|

| min_mask_area | 0.001| Allows tiny faces to be detected |

| crop_padding | 32–128| Extra space around face for better inpainting |

| inpaint_resolution | 1280| Higher = more detail in repainted face |

| denoise | 0.3–0.5| Lower = subtle changes, higher = more creative |

| steps | 6| Qwen Image works well with low steps |

| cfg | 1.0| Keep low for Qwen Image |

---

## 💡 Pro Tips

🔹 Small or distant faces not detected?

→ Lowermin_mask_areato0.0005andtext_thresholdto0.25

🔹 Inpainting looks blurry?

→ Raiseinpaint_resolutionto1280or1536

🔹 Edges look harsh?

→ Useblend_mode: featherand increasemask_blur

🔹 Want to inpaint more than faces?

→ Change the SAM prompt to"hat", "logo", "hands"— it will find and repaint that area

🔹 Batch generation too slow?

→ Enable CacheDiT and use fp8 models for faster runs

## ⚠️ Important Notes

🔸 This workflow is designed for Qwen Image 2512— other models may need parameter adjustments

🔸 I do not monitor this post— I may not reply to comments or issues. This is shared for the community to use and improve.

🔸 Always test with one image firstbefore running large batches

Happy creating! ✨👫🖼️
